# netskope_destination_profile (Data Source)

DestinationProfile DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_destination_profile" "my_destinationprofile" {
  profile_id = "...my_profile_id..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `profile_id` (String) Destination profile UUID

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Profile description (max 200 characters)
- `label_ids` (List of String) Associated label IDs
- `name` (String) Profile name (max 100 characters)
- `type` (String) Matching type for values
- `values` (List of String) List of destination URLs/domains
